name: andy-monorepo
description: Remote Electrician Lab (Andy) — frontend circuit lab + AI diagram-to-YAML server.

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev -w @andy/server & npm run dev -w @andy/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @andy/frontend && npm run build -w @andy/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @andy/frontend && npm run test -w @andy/server && npm run test -w @andy/react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @andy/server && npm run typecheck -w @andy/react
